🌾 About IAL Heho

The Institute of Agriculture and Livestock (Heho), located in Kalaw Township of Shan State, is Myanmar's premier practical agricultural training center. Situated in the cool Shan highlands, the institute offers 70% hands-on training across 100+ acres of working demonstration farms.

Specializing in highland agriculture perfect for Shan plateau crops (cabbage, potato, coffee, tea) and livestock management, IAL Heho produces skilled agricultural technicians ready for immediate employment.
